mapper.select: select purpose from p_application where id=#{applicationId} and account_id=#{accountId} and status='ACTIVE' and admin_disabled=0
select id from p_quota_balance where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type='TTS_CHAR' for update

select id,reserved_units reservedUnits,state from p_quota_reservation where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type='TTS_CHAR' and business_type='TTS_SEGMENT' and business_id=#{businessId} and reservation_no=1

select id,reserved_units reservedUnits,state from p_quota_reservation where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type='TTS_CHAR' and business_type='TTS_SEGMENT' and business_id=#{businessId} and reservation_no=1 for update
mapper.update: update p_quota_balance set reserved_units=reserved_units+#{units},revision=revision+1, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type='TTS_CHAR' and granted_units-used_units-reserved_units >= #{units}

update p_quota_reservation set state=#{state},settled_units=#{settledUnits}, settled_at=case when #{state}='SETTLED' then utc_timestamp(3) else null end, released_at=case when #{state}='RELEASED' then utc_timestamp(3) else null end, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and state in ('RESERVED','REVIEW_REQUIRED')
update p_quota_reservation set state='REVIEW_REQUIRED',updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and state='RESERVED'
